title: Captain's Quarters Riverfront (Downtown)
description:
Beautiful Condo Downtown Riverfront- Walking distance from Broadway, Honky Tonk Central , LP Field, Bridgestone Arena, The Baseball Stadium, Restaurants, Music City Row, The Ryman, Top Golf and so much more! Free parking, wifi and HDTV. Lay by the pool or sit on the  balcony and enjoy the beauty of the river. The condo is fully stocked will ammenities. Coffee maker, linens, beautiful king bed and also a queen bed in the common area. Join me! Stay at one of the best places in downtown Nashville!
